name: Campingplatz Seehamer See
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Seehamer See is located in Weyarn in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. It lies directly on the shore of the lake of the same name. The surroundings are characterized by the Tiroler Alpen, which offer hiking opportunities and ski areas in winter. The atmosphere at the campsite is peaceful and close to nature. The amenities include sanitary facilities, electrical hookups, and pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. Guests can use the lake for swimming and water sports. Hikes and tours into the surrounding mountains start from the campsite. The campsite is suitable as a starting point for active holidaymakers and those seeking relaxation.
